filing.source_excerpt: [Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T19:05:15Z, by Benzinga Newsdesk] Merck And Moderna Report Phase 3 Melanoma Trial Results For Personalized mRNA Cancer Therapy; Intismeran Plus KEYTRUDA Cuts Melanoma Recurrence Or Death Risk By 42%

memos_so_far.headline: Confirms this morning's leak: HR 0.58 was already priced (MRNA -25% today); for Merck it is one Keytruda add-on
reasoning: Source: Merck and Moderna's joint release (Benzinga 19:05 UTC): 'Intismeran Plus KEYTRUDA Cuts Melanoma Recurrence Or Death Risk By 42%'. Phase 3 INTerpath-001, adjuvant stage IIB-IV melanoma, full data at ESMO 2026.

The number was public hours earlier. Benzinga 18:47 UTC: 'Moderna Inc. stock plunged more than 25% Thursday after the alleged leak of an ESMO 2026 conference abstract'; 'The allegedly leaked data indicated that intismeran plus Keytruda reduced the risk of cancer recurrence or death by 42%, with a hazard ratio of 0.58 ... below the 49% risk reduction observed in an earlier Phase 2b study'.
So today's release confirms the leak rather than adding to it. Since 15:05 ET: MRK -0.1%, MRNA -0.3%.
For Merck ($365B), the case's company, a combination that extends Keytruda in adjuvant melanoma is a small increment. MRK is -1.2% on the day.

For Moderna (MRNA, 245.94 to 184.12, -25.1%, ~2x normal IEX volume), the repricing happened this morning on the leak. Whether -25% overshoots a positive Phase 3 is a fair question, but it is a call on an already-moved stock, and the same-day move filter excludes it by design.
objections: The release confirms numbers leaked and traded hours earlier; immaterial for Merck.
